_doc: Accepted high/critical npm audit findings in the MOBILE app only (scripts/audit-gate.mjs).
gmp-core, electron and root runtime findings can never be listed here: the gate fails on them.
Each entry: package, its advisories (a new advisory on the package fails the gate), why it is accepted, and reviewBy (after that date the entry stops counting and the gate fails).
